description.narrative: The program will help Pakistan recover its current account deficit in a sustained manner and promote macroeconomic stability by facilitating improved trade competitiveness and exports. The program will (i) introduce important tariff and tax-related policy reforms to support Pakistan's export industry and improve its competitiveness internationally; and (ii) strengthen key institutions involved in facilitating trade, including accreditation bodies, the Export-Import Bank of Pakistan (EXIMBP), and the Pakistan Single Window (PSW). The proposed reforms will also facilitate export diversification.
